name: Better Dating Photos
tagline: **Better Dating Photos** helps people create realistic dating profile photos from a single selfie
description: **Better Dating Photos** helps people create realistic dating profile photos from a single selfie. It generates natural-looking photos for Tinder, Hinge, Bumble, and other dating apps, with a focus on authentic lifestyle portraits instead of generic AI headshots. Users can start free, choose photo styles, and create images designed to make dating profiles feel more confident, approachable, and real. Key features include: - **One photo input**: Upload a clear selfie; the AI uses it as an identity
